card.name: The letter d inside split compounds
card.fires_on: A lone "-d" piece that starts the second half of a compound after a prefix, as in single-dose, multiple-dose, predilute and horse-drawn. It appears in drug-label vial wording and in "drawn" compounds.

modes.label: Single/multiple-dose vials
modes.description: The "d" of "dose" after "single" or "multiple" when describing vials.

modes.label: Predilute
modes.description: The "d" starting "dilute" after the prefix "pre" in preparation instructions.
modes.example: Do not pre<<-d>>ilute BabyBIG before infusion.

modes.label: Drawn compounds
modes.description: The "d" of "drawn" after a noun such as horse or ox.

card.writes: It promotes forms of "draw", which fits the "-drawn" compounds, and suppresses unrelated odd tokens.
